nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Single-stage production image for the Personal AI gateway, built on uv's Python 3.14 slim base, installing the src package non-editable and the Job-Agent package editable with the discovery extra. Runtime state (SQLite DB and agent workspace) is intentionally excluded and arrives via mounted volumes; the container runs `python -m personal_ai.server` on port 8000.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-stage build relying on uv.lock as the single source of truth; --no-editable for the main package vs --editable for job_agent to keep runtime data at /app/job_agent.

nodes.name: base
nodes.summary: Base build stage defining the uv python3.14-bookworm-slim runtime environment, copying dependencies first for layer caching, then installing src and job_agent, and exposing port 8000 for the gateway.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Docker Compose deployment for the Personal AI gateway. Builds the Dockerfile into the `personal-ai` service on two external networks (open-webui_default and ollama_default) so Open WebUI can reach it at http://personal-ai:8000/v1 and it can reach Ollama, with no host firewall exposure, persistent /data volumes for SQLite databases and the agent workspace, and a /v1/models healthcheck.
nodes.languageNotes: Publishes no direct host port; joins two external compose networks to route Open WebUI -> gateway -> Ollama through shared bridges.
